rationale: C05 is a near-exact predecessor template. It invokes the same section 4731(g) definition, uses the same finding after notice and hearing, presents a numbered list of drugs, and concludes with materially identical operative language proclaiming that each listed drug has addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine and that the finding should take effect immediately. C21 and C12 share the same machinery and much of the language, but C05 is strongest because its plural, numbered-list structure most precisely matches the child.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Whereas section 4731 (g) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1954 provides in part as follows: OPIATE.—The word "opiate" ...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Whereas section 4731 (g) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1954 provides in part as follows: Opiate. The word "opiate" ...
shared_material.explanation: Both begin by quoting the same statutory provision and materially identical definition.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the Secretary of the Treasury, after due notice and opportunity for public hearing, has found that each of the following-named drugs has an addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the Secretary of the Treasury, after due notice and opportunity for public hearing, has found that each of the following-named drugs has an addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine
shared_material.explanation: This distinctive finding recital is reproduced essentially verbatim and followed in both directives by a numbered drug list.

shared_material.child_excerpt: do hereby proclaim that the Secretary of the Treasury has found that each of the aforementioned drugs has an addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine and that in the public interest this finding should be effective immediately
shared_material.parent_excerpt: do hereby proclaim that the Secretary of the Treasury has found that each of the aforementioned drugs has an addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine and that in the public interest this finding should be effective immediately
shared_material.explanation: The operative proclamation is effectively verbatim, demonstrating both literal reuse and the same administrative mechanism adapted to newly listed drugs.
